scope: Focused paired REVIEW02, REVIEW12 and REVIEW17 verification. No application source edits or production actions.

conclusions.finding_disposition: Unsupported-token rejection and same-prompt valid retry are verified. A production token-contract defect is not established.
conclusions.candidate: Both opaque and missing-iat headers are rejected; original expired access is retained; Timeout remains recoverable. A valid retry installs exact response access, closes Timeout and validates200/resulttrue.
conclusions.baseline: After malformed response, final snapshot shows SignIn and no access. Fresh-context valid controls both install real access, close Timeout and validate200/resulttrue. Transient installation of malformed access was not sampled.
limits: Malformed response substitutions do not match inspected local BFF token generation.
Fresh-context baseline control proves normal renewal availability, not recovery of the prior malformed session.
conclusions.next_action: Bind deployed provider guarantees before treating malformed-token rejection as a defect.

conclusions.finding_disposition: Persistent loader impact not reproduced in either actual browser route.
conclusions.candidate: Candidate briefly publishes loading during auth expiry routing; Login mount clears it. SignIn input is actionable after2.5seconds.
conclusions.baseline: Loading clears and SignIn input is actionable after2.5seconds.
limits: Synthetic401 drives the actual public Service, authentication handler, reducer and Routing chain.
Alternative unsupported epoch changes are not exercised.
conclusions.next_action: Keep only separately identified reachable stale-loader hypotheses open.

conclusions.finding_disposition: Usable successful renewal delivered after refresh expiry succeeds in both revisions. No blocking defect demonstrated.
conclusions.candidate: Provider accepts near refreshDeadline-5seconds. Successful response arrives after refresh expiry while returned access remains usable. Exact response access installs, Timeout closes and BFF validation200/resulttrue.
conclusions.baseline: Same asserted successful final predicates pass.
limits: Natural local timing uses60second access and short refresh fixture. Production policy and frequency remain unbound.
conclusions.next_action: Retain this successful late-delivery control and bind production provider policy separately.

conclusions.finding_disposition: Long successful-response hold does not establish acceptance of expired returned access.
conclusions.candidate: Already signed out before delayed delivery. No access remains afterward.
conclusions.baseline: Home remains with the original expired access before and after delivery; independent validation returns401/resultfalse.
limits: Successful response held roughly120seconds exceeds configured Axios60second timeout. Timeout is a source-backed explanation; the requestfailed event was not captured.
Raw disposition EXPIRED_RETURNED_ACCESS_NOT_INSTALLED compares final state only. It must be read as accepted response access absent at final observation.
Absence at the final snapshot cannot prove access was never installed transiently.
conclusions.next_action: Use the near-deadline control for late successful delivery; retain this separate bounded timeout observation.
